subject: GreenLeaf trial: compute commitments & success metrics (POC plan)
messages:
From: Maria Alvarez <maria@greenleaf.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for the demo — POC scope & questions

Soojin,

Thanks again for the walkthrough today — that clarified a lot. As discussed, we'd like a short written recap and proposed success criteria so our engineering and procurement teams can align. A few items we care about up front:

- Target latency: 95th percentile sub-250ms for single-turn generation (1k tokens).
- Throughput: support ~40 concurrent inference sessions during peak hours.
- Cost target: keep per-1k-token cost under $0.65 where feasible.
- Data controls: confirm that logs for trial can be disabled and that we can run in a VPC for the POC.

Also: our eval window is two weeks with a possible extension to four. Can you confirm recommended GPU footprint (reserved vs autoscale) and whether we can burst for load tests?

Attaching the internal evaluation template so you can map criteria.

Best,
Maria
Senior Product Manager, GreenLeaf AI

Attachment: greenleaf-eval-template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria@greenleaf.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — POC scope & questions

Maria — thanks for the great conversation. Below is a concise post-call recap plus our proposed POC plan and immediate asks so you can share with procurement/eng.

Post-call recap (short):
- Goal: Two-week hands-on trial to validate latency, concurrency, and cost with your typical prompts and a 75k-token/day load profile.
- Primary success metrics: 95p latency < 250ms; 99p latency < 500ms for single-turn; throughput sustaining 40 concurrent sessions; qualitative model output parity for top-3 intents (we'll define tests).

Proposed compute footprint (initial):
- Reserved baseline: 1 x A40-equivalent (baseline serving for steady state).
- Autoscale policy: add up to +2 GPUs on spikes (burst cap = 3 total).
- Burst expectation: short bursts to 3 GPUs for load tests (max sustained for 10–20 minutes).
- Caching: enable prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts to reduce token compute by ~20–35% depending on reuse.

Why this setup: minimizes committed cost while giving headroom for peak tests. If you want conservative latency SLAs for the whole trial we can convert to 2 reserved GPUs with lower autoscale headroom.

Operational items & owners:
- Onboarding runbook + eval checklist: see attached POC runbook (I’ll update per your eval template). Owner: Soojin Lee.
- Capacity/config validation + cost estimate: Owner: Marcus Lin (infra sizing).
- Eval harness & intent test cases: Owner: Karthik Iyer (platform integrations).
- Tech touch + kickoff meeting: Jordan Blake (solutions) to schedule.

Next steps (please):
1) Confirm trial start week (we suggested May 31 – Jun 4 kickoff window).
2) Confirm VPC requirement / logs-off preference for the trial.
3) Share sample prompt sets and a small representative dataset for throughput testing.

I attached a draft POC runbook and a quick capacity worksheet. Happy to jump on a 30–45m follow-up to lock dates.

Thanks,
Soojin
Sr. Solutions Lead — Redwood Inference

Attachments: greenleaf-poc-runbook-v1.pdf, capacity-estimate-GLF.xlsx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: GreenLeaf POC — capacity ask and timeline (needs validation)

Team,

Following a discovery call with GreenLeaf (Maria), they want a two-week trial starting the week of May 31 (flexible). Key constraints: 40 concurrent sessions peak, 75k tokens/day, tight latency targets (95p <250ms). They prefer minimal committed spend but need bursts for load tests.

Please validate the following and respond by EOD Tue so I can confirm with GreenLeaf on Wed:
- Is 1x A40-reserved + autoscale to 3 GPUs realistic for meeting 95p <250ms for their workload? If not, recommend minimal reserved and autoscale knobs.
- Rough cost delta for: reserved=1 vs reserved=2 for a two-week POC (include burst costs).
- Any networking/VPC gotchas for a short private trial (we may need to spin a temporary VPC attachment).

Deal: GLF-2027-1123 (GreenLeaf). I’ve attached their eval template and our runbook.

Thanks — Soojin

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2027 11:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GreenLeaf POC — capacity ask and timeline (needs validation)

Soojin — quick sizing notes after a short sim against their profile: 

- Recommendation: baseline 1 x A100s (or cloud A40 equivalent is borderline for their 95p target). For a conservative POC with sub-250ms 95p we should reserve 2 x A100-equivalent if GreenLeaf expects production-like latency under sustained load.
- Autoscaling: allow burst to 3 GPUs for <30 minutes bursts. Use a rapid scale policy (10–30s scale up) and a slightly slower scale down to avoid thrash.
- Cost sketch (two-week POC):
  - Option A (lower commit): 1 reserved GPU + autoscale -> est $X,XXX total (includes burst).
  - Option B (higher SLA): 2 reserved GPUs -> est ~$Y,YYY total (more predictable latency).

Operational suggestions:
- Enable KV/prefix caching in the runbook; will likely cut effective token compute by ~25% for reuse-heavy flows.
- For the VPC trial: we can attach a temporary private endpoint; latency impact negligible but provisioning takes ~48 hours.

I'll attach a brief capacity worksheet (capacity-estimate-GLF.xlsx) with the sim numbers. If GreenLeaf is cost-sensitive, start with 1 reserved and set a strict burst cap (3) — if they want to validate tight latency we should propose 2 reserved.

Happy to sync with Maria after you present these options.

—Marcus
Sr. Infrastructure PM — Redwood Inference

Attachment: capacity-estimate-GLF.xlsx

From: Maria Alvarez <maria@greenleaf.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: solutions@greenleaf.ai
Date: Thu, 07 May 2027 09:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GreenLeaf POC — capacity ask and timeline (needs validation)

Soojin & team,

Thanks — that level of detail is super helpful. We’re inclined to start with Option A (1 reserved + burst to 3) and run the two-week window, but would like the ability to flip to Option B quickly if latency regressions appear during the first 24–48 hours of the trial. Please confirm:

- Can Redwood commit to a 48-hour escalation path to increase reserved capacity if we observe >10% of test-cases missing the 95p SLA?
- Estimated provisioning lead time if we need to convert to 2 reserved GPUs mid-trial?
- Confirm you’ll disable long-term logging for trial traces and provide guidance on toggling it back on.

We’re happy to sign a short POC agreement and proceed with the May 31 kickoff if those items are acceptable.

Best,
Maria
Senior Product Manager, GreenLeaf AI
